pages.text: $(4)Berserker's Fury$() is a Corrupted enchantment that can be applied to chestplates.$(p)While using this enchantment, if you take damage, you will take additional damage and receive Resistance, Speed, and Strength.

Triggering requires damage from an attacker, and has a cooldown.$(p)You take exponentially more damage per level, which bypasses armor and Resistance.$(p)The buffs last 25 seconds, at a strength equal to the level.
